e.title: 中国保险行业协会（中保协）
e.title_hk: 中國保險行業協會（中保協）
e.summary: 行业示范条款与费率标准发布方：车险/寿险示范条款、农险示范条款、意外险发生率研究
e.summary_en: Publisher of industry model clauses and rate standards: motor and life model clauses, agricultural insurance model clauses, accident-incidence research
e.summary_hk: 行業示範條款與費率標準發布方：車險/壽險示範條款、農險示範條款、意外險發生率研究
e.body: 中国保险行业协会（中保协，`iachina.cn`）是**中国保险业的自律组织与行业标准发布方**，其网站的价值集中在「**条款费率**」与「实践研究 / 研究报告」两块。可核实的近期与常设内容：《车险承保理赔实务指南（2026版）》（2026-08 印发）、人身保险业**利率研究专家咨询委员会**季度例会机制、《定期寿险示范条款》与《终身寿险示范条款》修订、《反保险欺诈数据元》协会标准公开征求意见、重点新材料首批次应用保险示范条款及费率表，以及**玉米 / 小麦 / 水稻成本保险行业示范条款**（编号形如 `BXMC2020NXYM0101`）；研究侧有意外险基础发生率研究与承保理赔数据归集分析、寿险及护理保险转换机制研究、《中国保险业社会责任报告（2024）》。对 RIAA：**行业示范条款是产品开发的基准**——在中国做产品定价，条款责任边界直接决定发生率口径与费率结构，而示范条款给出了全行业的公共起点；农险示范条款可与 [[agrisky-ai]]（农险查勘定损 agent）对照「条款标准 → 实务执行」的链路；与 [[china-insurance-regulatory-updates]]（新规速递）、[[nfra-statistics]]（监管统计）、[[non-motor-insurance-product-skill]]、[[cn-nonlife-ratemaking-course]] 搭配使用；适合作产品开发、条款实务与国内市场方向。
e.body_en: The China Insurance Association (IACHINA, `iachina.cn`) is **the Chinese insurance industry’s self-regulatory body and standards publisher**, and its site concentrates value in two areas: **clauses and rates** and **practice research / research reports**. Verifiable recent and standing content includes: the *Motor Insurance Underwriting and Claims Practice Guide (2026 edition)* (issued 2026-08); a quarterly expert advisory committee on **interest-rate research** for the life sector; revisions to the *Term Life Model Clauses* and *Whole Life Model Clauses*; an industry standard on *Anti-Insurance-Fraud Data Elements* out for consultation; model clauses and rate tables for first-batch application insurance for key new materials; and **model clauses for corn / wheat / rice cost insurance** (IDs such as `BXMC2020NXYM0101`). On the research side: baseline accident-incidence research and claims-data aggregation analysis, research on life-to-long-term-care conversion mechanisms, and the *China Insurance Industry Social Responsibility Report (2024)*. For RIAA: **model clauses are the baseline of product development** — pricing in China depends on clause liability boundaries that directly determine incidence bases and rate structures, and the model clauses supply the industry’s common starting point; the agricultural model clauses can be read against [[agrisky-ai]] (an agricultural claims agent) as a "clause standard → operational execution" chain; use it with [[china-insurance-regulatory-updates]], [[nfra-statistics]], [[non-motor-insurance-product-skill]] and [[cn-nonlife-ratemaking-course]]; suits product development, clause practice and domestic-market work.
e.body_hk: 中國保險行業協會（中保協，`iachina.cn`）是**中國保險業的自律組織與行業標準發布方**，其網站的價值集中在「**條款費率**」與「實踐研究 / 研究報告」兩塊。可核實的近期與常設內容：《車險承保理賠實務指南（2026版）》（2026-08 印發）、人身保險業**利率研究專家諮詢委員會**季度例會機制、《定期壽險示範條款》與《終身壽險示範條款》修訂、《反保險欺詐數據元》協會標準公開徵求意見、重點新材料首批次應用保險示範條款及費率表，以及**玉米 / 小麥 / 水稻成本保險行業示範條款**（編號形如 `BXMC2020NXYM0101`）；研究側有意外險基礎發生率研究與承保理賠數據歸集分析、壽險及護理保險轉換機制研究、《中國保險業社會責任報告（2024）》。對 RIAA：**行業示範條款是產品開發的基準**——在中國做產品定價，條款責任邊界直接決定發生率口徑與費率結構；農險示範條款可與 [[agrisky-ai]] 對照「條款標準 → 實務執行」的鏈路；與 [[china-insurance-regulatory-updates]]、[[nfra-statistics]]、[[non-motor-insurance-product-skill]]、[[cn-nonlife-ratemaking-course]] 搭配使用；適合作產品開發、條款實務與國內市場方向。
